cutoff_and_scale: At the 1689 point use that round's actual neutral unit and reported four physical pole masses. For the family of rescaled models compare fixed flavor cutoff with keeping cutoff/neutral-unit fixed.
threshold_convention: One light SM doublet, u=v/sqrt(2); per-pole one-loop MSbar m_H^2 finite matching at mu_i=M_i exp(-3/4). Independent quadratic boundary and other sectors set to zero only in the declared neutrino-option hypothesis.
